summary_1line: A jackal—revealed as Indra—teaches Kasyapa that contentment, duty, and restraint are superior to despair and endless desire.

image_candidates.scene_text: A miserable jackal covered with biting worms speaks to the despairing ascetic Kasyapa in the wilderness.
Kasyapa suddenly perceives the jackal transform into Indra, radiant and mounted on his celestial steed.
The jackal laments his past life, surrounded by earth and crawling worms he cannot brush away without hands.
